units.rawText: I hate it when people ask me about my past. What does my past say about me? People determine what I'm worth based on just a few rows of text on my resume and don't even consider what I can actually offer...

units.rawText: Am I being too harsh? These are my genuine thoughts.

units.rawText: I knew you would be different. From the very start, you've seen me for who I am, not "the Doll of the same model as Hatsuchiri."

units.rawText: So I will treat you the same way no matter who you actually are in the real world. I will do everything I can to repay what you have done for me, so keep your eyes on me... please.
